title: A/B test hell: 2-day user punished harder than my friends
body:
UPDATE: Posted 5 stars by accident couple days ago. Changing to 1 star.

I downloaded Duolingo 2 days ago in France for “learning should be fun”. I’m at 1300 XP from ~15 lessons + 2 hours grinding “Lucy is Listening” just to keep going.

But my app is broken and it’s putting me at a huge disadvantage:

1. Max 25 battery, +1 per hour. To max it out I have to log in every single hour and click +5 ad. That’s 4 hours just to fill it. Way too long. Nobody learns like that.

2. I lose 1 battery EVERY time I answer, right OR wrong. 1 mistake = lesson over. My friends in Ireland on the exact same app version, same phone, only lose battery when WRONG. I’m stuck with “per answer” battery in France while they have normal “per lesson” battery in Ireland. Same app, different rules = unfair. So I’m punished harder for the same effort.

3. Practice Hub takes battery too even though it shouldn’t. The whole point of “Practice” is to learn without penalty. But I still lose energy there.

4. I get bombarded with 3 billion ads every time I finish a round. Finish lesson → ad. Practice → ad. Watch ad for +5 battery → ad after. It never stops.

5. Refill costs 600 gems which is way too much for new users

title: Extremely frustrating experience, especially for business travel.
body:
I booked this stay for business and expected Airbnb to provide a proper invoice with the correct guest and payment information. Unfortunately, once the reservation is completed, Airbnb does not allow the invoice to be edited or corrected, even when the information is clearly incorrect.

In my case, the payment information was under the guest’s name, and the invoice should have reflected him as the guest as well. Airbnb support essentially told me that there was no option for them—or for us—to make changes after the reservation was completed.

This is a major problem for anyone using Airbnb for business travel, expense reimbursement, or company accounting. How are customers supposed to know an invoice is incorrect if they cannot even review or correct the information until after it has already been processed?

The fact that Airbnb’s system allows incorrect invoicing information to be generated but provides no reasonable way to fix it afterward is extremely disappointing. Support should have the ability to escalate and correct obvious invoicing errors rather than simply telling customers that nothing can be done.

Airbnb needs to provide a clear way to correct invoices after booking,

title: Airbnb - Horrible mob like behavior
body: We booked a 50-night Airbnb stay, and on day 4 a broken gate (which the host had reportedly known about for 2 months) and a defective window fell and injured both of us. Airbnb’s own rep calculated and we accepted a specific refund in writing, but a day later a different rep called it a “preliminary estimate,” cited a vendor statement contradicted by our own timestamped photos, and closed our case twice in one day without giving us a real chance to respond. Weeks later, despite a formal demand letter, we still haven’t received the refund Airbnb itself agreed to, and cancelling the remaining reservation would have triggered a penalty owed to the same host whose property injured us. Be cautious with long-term bookings and don’t assume a written refund agreement from support will actually be honored.
